_doc: Registry of /data map layers. Served via /api/data/layers. Every layer is labeled kind: 'raw' (as-is display, source attribution, no predictive claim) or 'signal' (interpreted reading; may not surface before ROOT VALIDATION LADDER gate 2). Status: live | awaiting_key | planned.

layers.name: Terrain (hillshade)
layers.source: Mapterhorn terrain tiles (Copernicus GLO-30 + national open DEMs; © Mapterhorn)
layers.description: Global elevation hillshade rendered under all data layers. Off by default — the imagery base already shows relief; this is the opt-in accent (and the DEM source future 3D terrain reuses).

layers.name: Weather radar (US)
layers.description: US base-reflectivity radar mosaic, refreshed ~5 min, rendered under all data layers. COVERAGE HONESTY: US + territories only — no free lawful global radar source exists (RainViewer and Open-Meteo free tiers prohibit our use). Global temp/wind fields can activate later via an OpenWeatherMap free key (human action filed).

layers.name: Temperature (global)
layers.source: OpenWeatherMap free tier (Weather data © OpenWeatherMap; attribution required)
layers.description: Global surface-temperature field, model-derived (not station truth — labeled per the licensing register). Tiles proxied server-side so the API key is never exposed and the 60-calls/min free budget is shared-cache bounded. Fresh keys take ~2h to activate on OWM's side — the layer shows a retry note, not an error, until then.

layers.name: Wind (global)
layers.source: OpenWeatherMap free tier (Weather data © OpenWeatherMap; attribution required)
layers.description: Global wind-speed field, model-derived (not station truth). Same proxied-key + shared-cache + fresh-key-retry behavior as the temperature layer.

layers.name: Live aircraft (ADS-B)
layers.description: Live aircraft positions; updates ~10s. No predictive claim.

layers.name: Live vessels (AIS)
layers.description: Live ship positions via AIS websocket. Goes live automatically when AISSTREAM_KEY is set (free signup — see wishlist).

layers.name: Live trains (rail)
layers.description: Live passenger-rail positions. Coverage: Finland + Norway (launch). US freight positions are proprietary — no free source exists.

layers.name: Strategic sites
layers.description: Cushing OK tank farms, major steel mills, top US ports.

layers.name: US power plants
layers.source: Global Power Plant Database v1.3.0 (WRI, CC BY 4.0)
layers.description: All ~9,800 US plants by fuel type; capacity + operator on click. Static reference data (2021 vintage).

layers.name: Insider transactions (Form 4)
layers.description: Recent Form 4 filings (insider buys/sells/grants) as filed. As-is display, no predictive claim — clustering-vs-returns is an open gate-2 question, not yet surfaced as a signal.

layers.name: Dark-ship statistics
layers.source: Derived from our own AIS archive (terrestrial coverage)
layers.description: Event COUNTS from our own vessel archive: AIS gap events (silent >6h, reappeared >100km away), identity-change candidates, loitering in known STS/transshipment zones. A gap can be coverage loss, not dark sailing — per-vessel shadow-fleet claims are SIGNAL-class and stay gated until validated (ladder gate 1).

layers.name: Port dwell (arrivals/departures)
layers.source: Derived from our own AIS archive + imagery-verified port geofences
layers.description: Per-port vessel dwell statistics from our own archive: completed calls, ships in port now, median/p90 dwell, and 3x-median anomaly FLAGS (suppressed under 10 completed calls — thin history). Dwell figures are lower bounds (coverage gaps split visits). The dwell-anomaly SIGNAL (congestion predicts returns) stays gated at ladder gate 2 vs published congestion indices.

layers.name: Active fires (VIIRS)
layers.source: NASA FIRMS / LANCE (VIIRS 375m NRT; free MAP_KEY)
layers.description: Active-fire detections, ~3h latency. Not for safety-of-life use. Goes live automatically when NASA_FIRMS_MAP_KEY is set (free registration — see wishlist). No free history exists upstream — detections archive from the day the key activates.

layers.name: Tank-fill % (Sentinel-2)
layers.description: GATED: may not surface before ladder gate 2 (statistical validation vs EIA ground truth).
